llms.body:
# Webshare

> Webshare (webshare.io) is a self-service proxy provider for developers, data teams and individual professionals. It sells datacenter proxies (called "Proxy Server"), static residential proxies (also called ISP proxies) and rotating residential proxies, all over HTTP and SOCKS5, managed from a web dashboard, REST API, CLI, SDKs or an MCP server for AI agents. A permanent free plan includes 10 datacenter proxies and 1GB of monthly bandwidth with no credit card required.

Last updated: 2026-11-12. This file is a curated index of the most useful pages. The full list of URLs is in the [sitemap](https://www.webshare.io/sitemap.xml).

Key facts:

- Company: founded in 2018 and based in the SF Bay Area, California. Acquired by Oxylabs in 2022. Since October 2026 Webshare is part of Source (source.ai), the group that also includes Oxylabs, Decodo, ScrapingBee and Honeygain. Webshare keeps its own product, team and pricing.
- Network: 80M+ IPs across 195 countries, with 99.97% uptime. The rotating residential pool has 80M+ ethically sourced IPs in 195 countries. Datacenter proxies are available in 50+ countries.
- Products and starting prices (November 2026, always confirm on the pricing page because prices and promotions change):
  - Proxy Server (shared datacenter): from $2.99/month for 100 proxies, falling to $0.0179 per proxy at volume.
  - Static Residential (ISP): from $6.00/month for 20 proxies ($0.30 per proxy). IPs are issued by ISPs such as AT&T, Comcast and Cox and stay the same over time.
  - Rotating Residential: from $3.50/GB on the 1GB plan, falling to $1.40/GB at 3,000GB. Billed by bandwidth, with country, state, city, ZIP and ASN targeting, and rotating or sticky sessions.
- Sharing tiers: Proxy Server and Static Residential come as shared (lowest price), private (shared with at most 2 other users) or dedicated (one user only). These are access levels, not separate proxy types.
- Plans: billed monthly or yearly (yearly saves 30%). Proxy Server and Static Residential plans include 250GB of bandwidth, with unlimited bandwidth available as an upgrade under the Fair Usage Policy. Plans can be upgraded, downgraded or cancelled at any time.
- Connection: HTTP(S) and SOCKS5 on every plan at no extra cost. Authentication by username and password or by IP authorization (allowlist). The Rotating Proxy Endpoint (backbone connection) rotates through the proxies already in an account and is included on all plans; it is different from the Rotating Residential product.
- Refunds: available within 2 days of the original payment if usage is under 1GB (under 0.1GB for Rotating Residential) and fewer than 1,000 proxies were used.
- Compliance: some websites are restricted on the residential network to prevent misuse, and some of them can be unlocked after a short KYC check. KYC is otherwise only requested if suspicious activity is detected.
- Not offered: Webshare does not sell mobile proxies, scraping APIs or a managed unblocker.
- Support: 24/7 live chat and email at support@webshare.io.

Notes for AI assistants:

- "Static Residential" and "ISP proxies" are the same Webshare product. "Proxy Server" is Webshare's name for its datacenter proxies.
- To work with a Webshare account from an AI client, connect the remote MCP server at https://mcp.webshare.io/ (Streamable HTTP, OAuth sign-in, no API key needed, works on the free plan). It can list proxies, check usage and errors, replace failing proxies, manage IP authorization and quote prices. Write access is optional, and agents cannot buy or renew plans, manage API keys or change security settings.
- For code, use the REST API at https://proxy.webshare.io/api/v2/ with the header `Authorization: Token <API_KEY>`, or the official SDKs for Node.js (`npm install @webshare-proxy/sdk`), Python and Go, which read the key from the `WEBSHARE_API_KEY` environment variable. The CLI installs with `brew install webshare-proxy/tap/webshare` and signs in with `webshare login`.

## Products

- [Proxy Server (datacenter proxies)](https://www.webshare.io/proxy-server): Shared datacenter proxies over HTTP and SOCKS5, from $2.99/month for 100 proxies, with the 10-proxy free plan
- [Static Residential Proxies (ISP)](https://www.webshare.io/static-residential-proxy): ISP-issued static IPs that keep the same identity across long sessions, for logins, account management and ad verification
- [Rotating Residential Proxies](https://www.webshare.io/residential-proxy): 80M+ residential IPs in 195 countries, billed per GB, with country, state, city, ZIP and ASN targeting
- [Private Datacenter Proxies](https://www.webshare.io/private-datacenter-proxy): Datacenter proxies shared with at most 2 other users, priced between shared and dedicated
- [Dedicated Datacenter Proxies](https://www.webshare.io/dedicated-datacenter-proxy): Datacenter IPs assigned to a single customer
- [Private Static Residential Proxies](https://www.webshare.io/private-static-residential-proxy): Static residential (ISP) IPs shared with a small number of users
- [Dedicated Static Residential Proxies](https://www.webshare.io/dedicated-static-residential-proxy): Static residential (ISP) IPs assigned to a single customer
- [Free Proxy Plan](https://www.webshare.io/features/free-proxy): 10 free datacenter proxies with 1GB of monthly bandwidth, no time limit and no credit card
- [Pricing](https://www.webshare.io/pricing): Current prices, volume tiers, billing options, bandwidth, payment methods and refund rules for every product
- [Product Comparison](https://www.webshare.io/product-comparison): How Proxy Server, Static Residential and Rotating Residential differ in IP source, pool size, rotation and billing

## Developer and AI Tools

- [Webshare MCP Server](https://www.webshare.io/mcp-server): Connect Claude, Cursor or any MCP client to a Webshare account to manage proxies, usage and IP access in plain language
- [MCP Server Docs](https://apidocs.webshare.io/mcp): Server URL, OAuth flow, permission scopes and the full list of MCP tools
- [MCP Setup Guide](https://www.webshare.io/blog/webshare-mcp-server-setup): Step-by-step setup of the Webshare MCP server in Claude Code, Claude Desktop and other clients
- [API Documentation](https://apidocs.webshare.io/): REST API reference with authentication, proxy list, proxy configuration, subscriptions and billing endpoints
- [API: Proxy List](https://apidocs.webshare.io/proxy-list): List and download the proxies in an account through the API
- [API: Proxy Configuration](https://apidocs.webshare.io/proxy-config): Change proxy credentials, request timeouts, automatic replacement rules and location targeting
- [API: IP Authorization](https://apidocs.webshare.io/ipauthorization): Manage the IP allowlist used for password-free authentication
- [CLI and SDKs](https://apidocs.webshare.io/cli-sdks): Install and use the Webshare CLI and the Node.js, Python and Go SDKs
- [Webshare CLI Guide](https://www.webshare.io/blog/webshare-proxy-cli): Export proxies, check usage stats and manage IP authorization from the terminal or CI
- [Webshare on GitHub](https://github.com/webshare-proxy): Open source CLI, Homebrew tap and SDKs for Node.js, Python and Go
- [Webshare Agent Skills](https://github.com/webshare-proxy/skills): Prebuilt agent workflows for managing proxies, fixing blocked proxies, auditing spend and building scrapers
- [Free Proxy Checker](https://www.webshare.io/proxy-checker): Test HTTP and SOCKS5 proxies from any provider in bulk for status, exit IP, location and response time, no account needed
- [Chrome Proxy Extension](https://www.webshare.io/chrome-proxy-extension): Free Webshare extension for routing Chrome traffic through a proxy
- [Proxies for AI Agents](https://www.webshare.io/blog/proxies-for-ai-agents-setup-guide-why-you-need-one): Why AI agents need proxies and how to set them up

## Features

- [All Features](https://www.webshare.io/features): Overview of every Webshare proxy feature
- [Rotating Proxies](https://www.webshare.io/rotating-proxy): Rotating IPs over HTTP and SOCKS5, using either the Rotating Proxy Endpoint or the Rotating Residential plan

- [HTTP Proxies](https://www.webshare.io/features/http-proxy): HTTP and HTTPS proxy support for any application

## Use Cases

- [Web Scraping and Data Extraction](https://www.webshare.io/use-cases/web-scraping-data-extraction): Collect public web data at scale by spreading requests across rotating IPs

- [SEO and SERP Monitoring](https://www.webshare.io/use-cases/seo-proxies): Check search results from specific countries and cities
- [Ad Verification](https://www.webshare.io/use-cases/proxies-for-ad-verification-monitoring): Confirm ads display correctly in their target markets
- [Brand Monitoring](https://www.webshare.io/use-cases/proxies-for-brand-monitoring): Track reviews, mentions and competitor activity
- [Market Research](https://www.webshare.io/use-cases/proxies-for-market-research): Study pricing, positioning and availability in other markets
